name: Singapore
shortSummary: Singapore is one of India's most important economic partners — a leading source of foreign investment into India and its first comprehensive trade agreement with an ASEAN nation.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Singapore is consistently among the largest sources of FDI into India, partly via investment routing.
UPI-PayNow linkage enables real-time cross-border retail payments.

recentDevelopments.title: Continued fintech and investment ties deepen
recentDevelopments.description: The UPI-PayNow digital payment linkage and Singaporean investment into Indian infrastructure and startups continued expanding.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Reinforces Singapore's role as one of India's most important economic and financial gateways.

historicalEvents.title: Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement (CECA)
historicalEvents.description: India signs its first comprehensive economic partnership agreement with an ASEAN country.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic Partnership
historicalEvents.description: India and Singapore elevate relations to a Strategic Partnership.

agreements.name: Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement
agreements.description: India's first major bilateral trade and investment agreement with an ASEAN nation.

defenceCooperation.name: SIMBEX
defenceCooperation.description: One of India's longest-running bilateral naval exercises, held annually since 1994.

multilateralRelations.detail: Key India partner in the Act East Policy.
Cooperate closely on digital public infrastructure and fintech.
